players.product: Mozaic HAMR nearline HDDs (44TB Mozaic 4+ -> 50TB Mozaic 5) for AI mass-capacity storage

quarterly_data.signal: Seagate's 10-Q: as of April 3, 2026 it had unconditional purchase obligations of approximately $1.9 billion, primarily for inventory components ($1.5 billion expected to be paid within one year), plus certain long-term, market share-based, non-cancellable inventory purchase commitments, and unconditional commitments of $312 million primarily for equipment (approximately $298 million expected within one year). Supporting the volume ramp of hard drives using HAMR technology, Seagate expects fiscal 2026 capital expenditures to be higher than fiscal 2025 and still within its target range of 4-6% of revenue; payments for capital expenditures were $382 million in the period from June 27, 2025 to April 3, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase obligations ~$1.9 billion ($1.5 billion within one year); equipment commitments $312 million (~$298 million within one year); capex payments $382 million (June 27, 2025 to April 3, 2026)
